initial_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished high-resolution Chinese mobile app UI design presentation board, landscape approx 2400 x 1600, three equally legible tall phone-screen panels side by side, editorial clean layout on warm ivory. This is the 同拍 / ONEBEAT app, established American comic ink style, not a generic music app, not wireframes.
Input images: supplied current app screenshots are REFERENCE for existing palette, typeface, ink outlines, beach/walking-video thumbnails and app visual identity. Redesign the works LIST and its management interaction; do not paste the old horizontal list. No new mascot designs. Preserve existing hand-drawn sunset ocean scene content in thumbnails.
Main board title exact: “我的作品 · 双列卡片与管理”. Under title small “浏览 → 选择 → 删除确认”.
Palette: warm cream #FFF9EE, pure white cards, ink-black #171B1F outlines, lavender #BBA6FF, coral #FF7056, small teal #29B5AE. Bold slightly italic Chinese headings. Solid black offset shadows ONLY, absolutely no blurred shadows, no gradients, no glass effects, corner radius visually equivalent 8vp outer / 6vp inner. Sparse purple/coral halftone decoration in BOARD margins only. Flat front-on app views, no physical phone chrome/bezel/perspective, very crisp simplified legible Chinese typography, all panels fully visible.

PANEL 1 external label exact “01 日常浏览” and smaller external caption “滚动至作品列表 · 上方预览与 MIC 调节保留”.
Show app screen focused on scrolled works-list region. Screen header back arrow, “单人练习作品”. Immediately a row showing existing “保存到相册” white outlined button with download icon and a smaller calendar-icon-only button. Then list heading “TAKES / 录制作品”, secondary count “6 段”, and top-right small lavender outlined hard-shadow button “管理”.
Below: TWO equal columns, THREE rows of portrait-ish video cards (taller than old compact rows). Tight but breathable 12vp-like gutter; equal card geometry, left aligned grid. Each card has a generous full-width top image approx 4:3 (hand-drawn sunset beach ocean and small walking avatars from screenshot, six different thumbnail crops from same scene; crop artwork carefully), black outlined 6vp corners, below picture cream/white footer approx 50vp tall. On image lower-right compact black badge with white duration e.g. “00:18”, “00:32”, “00:26”, “00:45”, “00:12”, “00:24”. Footer bold date “10月22日”, smaller “17:13”, then other times 16:48, 15:26, 14:05, 12:16, 10:32. First card pale warm-yellow active footer with a small lavender “正在预览” badge, no other badges. A small translucent ivory play circle centered in each thumbnail. NO delete × anywhere in normal mode. NO checkboxes in normal mode. NEVER display “画面 / 节奏 / MIC” on cards.
At screen bottom small neutral text “点击卡片，切换上方预览”. No persistent bottom management bar in this normal screen.

PANEL 2 external label exact “02 管理与多选” and smaller external caption “暂停预览 · 整张卡片点选 / 取消”.
Screen header back arrow, “管理作品”, right compact lavender “完成” button. Under header row “共 6 段作品” and right “已选 2 项”. Preview/MIC editing area temporarily hidden during management to let grid use full vertical space. Exact same TWO-column SIX-card grid, dates and thumbnails matching panel 1. In management there is NO play button on thumbnails. Each card upper-left a selection circle, first and third selected with lavender fill / white tick; the remaining 4 hollow white with black outline. First and third card subtly lavender tinted footers and slightly thicker ink border. In EACH card upper-right one TINY compact “×” in a light peach square, size visually HALF original 28vp control (14vp visual). This is separate from top-left selection control. Render crosses clearly small, not big close buttons.
Fixed bottom action bar above safe area, ivory fill and black top rule: left hollow-circle + “全选”, small “已选 2 项”, right dominant coral hard-shadow button “删除所选 (2)”. No delete action visually enabled when zero selected, but this illustrated state is 2 selected. Keep room beneath grid for bar, do not overlay last-row content.

PANEL 3 external label exact “03 删除前确认” and smaller external caption “小叉删除单项 · 底栏删除所选”.
Show same panel 2 management background under a uniform dark translucent scrim, and ONE centered comic-style ivory confirmation dialog with R8 corners thick ink border solid black offset shadow. Dialog title exact “删除这 2 段作品？”.
Dialog explanatory copy exactly on 2-3 short clear lines: “将从本机作品中移除，已保存到相册的副本不受影响。” No video thumbnail or extra illustration in confirmation.
Two equal-width bottom buttons, left white “取消”, right coral “删除 2 段”, both hard ink shadows. Under the dialog as an external board callout, NOT inside the app screen, one neat short label “删除成功后留在管理页，更新数量”.
Management panel’s behind-scrim header still “管理作品”, same grid.
Board footer has three compact separated annotations, exact:
“缩略图 + 日期时间 + 时长”
“删除叉视觉减半，保留触控热区”
“完成 / 返回：退出管理并清空选择”
No garbled English or decorative filler. Respect actual Chinese strings. Highly polished practical app mockup, image-based rendered full UI, not a wireframe. Make the three states feel exactly like one app.
correction_prompt: Edit only the attached UI design board. Preserve exactly the whole composition, all Chinese text, three panels, all colors, card geometry, thumbnails and bottom bars. ONE targeted correction: in the MIDDLE “02 管理与多选” panel, remove the white circular PLAY icon with black triangle from the center of the TOP-LEFT selected thumbnail, reconstructing the beach scene seamlessly. Management cards must have only top-left selection circles/checks and top-right tiny delete crosses; NO central play button on any management card. Apply the same correction to the corresponding darkened management background in the right panel if a central play icon is visible there. The LEFT “01 日常浏览” panel MUST retain all six circular play icons and time badges unchanged. Change nothing else.
